method: ENGINEERING native phone fixtures: elevated floor, healthy stationary actor, suppressed AI, no spread/recoil, explicit cover inserted during a held tracked burst. Not reproduction of specific reviewer timing, ordinary play, human comfort or performance. Physical shots, ammunition and actor health measured. Baseline observations and candidate assertions are separate.

checks.name: actual loss of tracked sight resolves cover without hidden damage; subsequent held burst is measured
FIRE dragging and independent MOVE remain live while stopped; only release/new FIRE rearms
a fresh intentional wall burst and disabled assistance retain continuous fire
lost tracking in open air cannot stop the rifle without a resolved cover impact
pause, map, rotation and fresh run clear stopped input without resume catch-up
reload and weapon change cannot carry pending occlusion into a later rifle press
